issues.detail: The Hebrew text does not contain the phrase 'vì họ đã làm ô uế' (because they defiled). The Hebrew reads 'upon the defilements of the priesthood' (עַל גָּאֳלֵי הַכְּהֻנָּה), referring to the defilements/pollutions of the priesthood, not an explicit statement that they defiled it. The Vietnamese adds a causal clause and a verb 'đã làm ô uế' that is not present in the Hebrew.
